## Lifetime at the nominal load (63.1 uA from the cell, 51.5 uA at the 3V3 rail)

Usable fraction of the nominal capacity: CR2450 50 / 60 / 70 % (reports fail once the cell's resistance has grown, docs/power_budget.md); CR123A 85 / 90 / 95 % (ASSUMED: the cell carries the bursts until its voltage collapses). Self-discharge 1 %/year.

| Cell | Nominal | Usable (low / mid / high) | Life (low / mid / high) |
|---|---|---|---|
| CR2450 with C5 (1 uA leakage) | 620 mAh | 310 / 372 / 434 mAh | 0.55 / 0.66 / 0.76 years |
| CR123A without C5 | 1550 mAh | 1318 / 1395 / 1472 mAh | 2.32 / 2.45 / 2.59 years |
